purpose: Teach: つたの/見込ま/名づけ/転がっ/くっつい/とどまる/はじまる/かかえ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の外壁につたのからまる演出いいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that ivy growing on the storefront is such a nice touch.
lines.style: Warm observation, slightly lifting at the end. Genuine appreciation without over-performing. Gentle tempo, the tone of someone sharing something she noticed and wants Aoi to feel good about.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、リピーターが見込まれるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That's going to bring people back, I think.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful. Speaking half to Mei, half to herself. Noticing the detail and its real effect. Slight pause before speaking, like she's turning the thought over.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューに名づけるアイデアを募集しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should ask customers to help name the new menu items.
lines.style: Bright, organizing tone. She's already thinking ahead. A little more energy than the last line — this is a plan forming in real time. Inclusive 'we,' not directive.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お皿の上のミニトマトが転がっちゃったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of the cherry tomatoes rolled right off a plate.
lines.style: Wry, affectionate — something small went wrong and she's not bothered. Light, quick delivery. Slight smile underneath. The tone of someone sharing a minor mishap without drama.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様にくっついてお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer was sitting with the little one the whole time, just talking.
lines.style: Soft, noticing tone. There's warmth in observing connection. Not loud or showy. The voice of someone who sees kindness and holds it gently, without comment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、長くとどまるお客様には水のお代わりをね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's keep the water coming for customers who settle in.
lines.style: Practical, clear instruction wrapped in warmth. Not bossy — collaborative. Steady rhythm, the voice of someone who knows hospitality and leads by example.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ランチタイムがはじまるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Lunch rush is about to start.
lines.style: Quick, alert. A gear-shift in energy — this is the signal. Brisk but not anxious. The tone of someone readying for work, inviting Aoi to do the same.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、重い荷物をかかえてお越しになったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer who just came in is carrying a lot — looks heavy.
lines.style: Observant, quiet noticing. A gentle alert. She's already thinking about what that customer might need. Slow pace, compassionate register. The voice of someone seeing beyond the surface.
